result.question: What does Elisha tell elders to do?

readings.answer: Shut the door to keep the messenger out when he comes.
readings.support: when the messenger comes, shut the door to keep him out

assessments.reason: Elisha instructs, “when the messenger comes, shut the door to keep him out,” which matches the key’s “shut and hold the door,” since keeping him out entails holding it closed.

result.reason: The text explicitly says to shut the door to keep the messenger out, which corresponds to shutting and holding the door.
